buildRationale: Explicit GNU89 matches original COMPILER_TYPE=gnu/CC=gcc project and Minix3.1.8 GNU4 toolchain evidence. Original GameController inline definitions remain unchanged. Default GNU11 leaves update_ingame unresolved atO2; GNU89 emits original external definitions and links. Shared SDK sys/video.h and libc namespace fixes supply original platform headers without student-name workarounds.
controlsRationale: Original1024×768 indexed game, boat starts800,500, scope50,50 with0.55 gain. Left WASD stick steers, right mouse stick or relative screen touch aims, separate Shoot/Select clicks.250ms minimum mobile button hold reliably reaches original timer-sampled edges, including game-over restart, after short unprotected taps sometimes missed. Both panels stay outside gameplay. Original art, movement, collisions, spawn RNG and UART code remain unchanged.

artwork.icon: Original numeric-palette tuba and ship XPM sprites decoded and composited on a simple dark tile; original asset arrays unchanged.
artwork.preview: Actual original boat moving right among approaching sharks, scaled to640×480.

verification.browser: Real CDP touch in844×390 and390×844 moves boat left then right, aims/fires, reaches original Game Over, selects Restart, verifies fresh field/cursor/boat reset and exits through Escape. No page errors.
verification.ndk: All24 authored source units plus generated context compile through exported CMake as actual ARM64 objects with app-globalC11, selected gameGNU89, O2/FORTIFY2/stack protector/format-security.
verification.limits: Original UART multiplayer unverified. Authored allocation macros print MALLOC/REALLOC FAILED unconditionally even on successful allocation; those diagnostics are retained.

nativeGameplay.demonstrated: ROOT reviewed actual native v3 attempt3: ordinary aimed Shoot removes the moving shark. Timestamped source-speed bound and raw gray-pixel check exclude motion, clipping, GameOver reset, boat overlap and scope occlusion.
limits: One defensible native shark removal and original Restart verified on current qualification APK.
